name: Point of Rocks Cemetery State Historic Site
official_page: https://www.blm.gov/visit/point-rocks-cemetery (BLM Wyoming, Rock Springs Field Office)
note: CHECK THE MATCH: the BLM page (the POTA link) describes the cemetery near the 'Point of Rocks Stage Station (Almond Stage Station)' and gives no acreage.
